title: Logs
description: Stream logs from Linux boards over SSH, and from files and commands on this computer.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: One entry for each log to record. On Linux, Auto-configure adds this computer's own system log.

read.title: Read
read.description: The system log is the journal, or syslog where there is no journal.

name.title: Name
name.description: How this source appears in the trace. Letters, digits, spaces, _ and -. Empty says where it reads: the host made safe (root@bench.local becomes bench_local), local or demo, then the file's name or the command's program.

host.title: Host
host.description: [user@]host, or a Host from your SSH config.

ssh_port.title: SSH port
ssh_port.description: Empty uses your SSH config, or 22.

key_path.title: Key file
key_path.description: A private key to use instead of your SSH agent, your default keys and the access key.

host_key_policy.title: Host key check
host_key_policy.description: A reflashed board gets a new host key. Check known_hosts refuses a key it does not know.

ssh_options.title: Extra ssh options
ssh_options.description: Passed to ssh before the options above, such as -J bastion.

history.title: History
history.description: On the first start, the journal sends the current boot, as far back as the agent keeps data. Other logs start at new lines.

time_source.title: Time
time_source.description: The device's clock places journal lines by the board's own monotonic time, so a board whose clock is wrong still lines up.

values.title: Printed values as signals
ui:enumNames: Off for the system log, on otherwise

path.title: File
path.description: The file to follow, such as /var/log/app.log. Rotation keeps working.

command.title: Command
command.description: Any command that prints lines, such as dmesg -w or adb logcat. Over SSH it runs in sh on the host.

path.title: File
path.description: A saved log file on this computer, plain or compressed with gzip, bzip2, xz or zstd. Its lines arrive at the pace they were printed, the first one now.

time_zone.title: Time zone
time_zone.description: The time zone of stamps that print none, such as Europe/Berlin. Empty uses this computer's.

year.title: Year
year.description: The year of the last stamp that prints none. Empty takes it from the file's last change.

start_time.title: Start time
start_time.description: When the first line printed, for a file that prints only uptime, such as 2026-10-21T14:03:01+02:00. Empty ends the file at its last change.

values.title: Printed values as signals
ui:enumNames: Off for the system log, on otherwise

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: The trace source every log publishes under.
